result:
I've implemented round 271: with Snap on, a dragged clip that sits off the grid now keeps its offset and moves in whole grid steps (4.3 → 5.3 → 6.3). There was no STOP. C has not checked it yet, and the gate rows (full test suite, build, verify, e2e smoke) were not run.

**What changed.** 9 files, all within the B task's file list. I used B's sketch with two changes to the logic in `grid.ts`:
- When a group of clips is blocked by a neighbour, the fallback is now worked out from the grid lines plus the offset, so it doesn't drift on musical grids.
- The code-reviewer found one Medium: on a musical grid that fallback could pass the neighbour's bound by less than 1 ms. B's sketch had the same bug (it gives 0.667 against a bound of 0.6667). The result is now checked against the bounds; if it doesn't fit, it steps one whole step back toward 0, or ends at 0. I added a test for this (RG2), which is one row more than B listed.

Library drop, trim, ranges, the loop brace and arrow-key nudge are unchanged. The Snap button's tooltip now reads "Snap on — clips follow the grid (G)". Doc 202 is new and doc 198 has only its status line changed.

**Checks I ran:**
- The 7 test files B listed: 197/197 pass. The slowest test is 926 ms, against a 15 s timeout and the 2500 ms STOP limit.
- Typecheck, lint, and Biome on the 7 changed code and test files are all clean. Lint reports 205 warnings across the whole repo, none in these files.
- All 8 of B's mutants fail exactly the tests B listed. My extra mutant for the bounds check fails RG2.
- The code-reviewer scored it 8/10 with no Critical issues and no architecture note. The Medium is fixed, plus one Low (a test loop variable renamed). The other three Lows are left as they are and written up in the report.

**Browser check (my own run, not C's).** I ran B's two probe scripts against :5173 at 1440×900 and 1280×720 with 0 page errors. The results match B's expected values at both sizes:
- small jitter leaves the clip at 10.300 with the "nothing changed" status;
- a move to another lane lands at 13.300;
- a group drag gives 11.300 / 16.000 with "Move (2): 2 clips moved 00:01.000 to the right.";
- trim still lands on 14.000 and arrow-key nudge on 11.000.

The first run timed out while the page was still loading and passed on the retry.

**Still open:** the two questions for Saba (whether arrow-key nudge should also keep the offset, and how an off-grid clip gets back onto the grid) and root's Live measurement. Alt pressed while Snap is off now snaps relatively too (HS2 7.5 → 7.525); doc 202 says so, but HS2's title was left as it is.

The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-271.md`. It lists the exact checks C should run next, including the extra mutant against RG2.
